title: Following Epic loss, Google has started hosting rival app stores in the Play Store
summary: Forcing Google to distribute third-party app stores in Google Play was one of several remedies imposed by Judge James Donato after Epic emerged victorious in 2023. The new third-party app stores page in Google Play is currently empty aside from Aptoide.
